title: Shaahe hardo sara ki rehlat hai
body:
Shehe har dosara ki rehlat hai,
Deen ke peshwa ki rehlat hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar barehna hai Anbiya saare,
Sarware Anbiya ki rehlat hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahlebaite Rasool rote hai,
Peeto sar Mustafa ki rehlat hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Daare fani se jarahe hai Rasool,
Ashraful Anbiya ki rehlat hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo shafa-at karega mehshar me,
Us shafiulwara ki rehlat hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham se phat'ta hai Fatima ka ghar,
Sayyadul Anbiya ki rehlat hai.
